# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Mark the relevant test as a fail.
3. Write the reason the test failed.
4. For visual inspections there is one mark available for each mark.
5. For functional testing there is one mark available for each function.
6. There is only ever one mark available for electrical safety and it must explain why/how the inspection will not keep intended users electrically safe in normal operation.
7. If an external engineer is required and that engineer rectifies the issue make sure that they mark the test record as a pass after successfuly completing the test.

# What happens next
